data.name: send slack message (template)
data.evaluateGuide:
Publishes a text message to Slack through the chat message API, allowing an agent to notify a user or channel with supplied content.
Use for: send a notification, post templated text, deliver an alert
Not supported: listing channels, reading messages, editing or deleting messages

data.name: Send a message to a channel using Slack
data.evaluateGuide:
Delivers a message to Slack through an incoming webhook URL, allowing an agent to post predefined content to its configured destination.
Use for: send an alert, post an automated update, publish a channel notification
Not supported: choosing arbitrary channels, reading messages, listing channels

data.name: slack-post-message
data.evaluateGuide:
Posts a message to Slack with the chat message API, enabling an agent to deliver text to a specified conversation.
Use for: send a channel message, post an event update, notify a Slack conversation
Not supported: listing channels, reading messages, editing or deleting messages

data.name: Send a message to a channel using Slack

data.name: slack-channels
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists public and private Slack conversations, enabling an agent to discover available channels and their identifiers.
Use for: find channels, list private channels, discover conversation IDs
Not supported: sending messages, reading channel history, creating channels

data.name: Check Answer and Send Result to Slack
data.description: Checks If User Answered Correctly or Not and Send the Result to Slack.
data.evaluateGuide:
Checks whether a user answer is correct and sends the result to Slack through the supplied response endpoint.
Use for: evaluate a trivia answer, send a quiz result, report correctness
Not supported: general message lookup, channel discovery, updating Slack messages

data.name: Send Slack Message via Channel

data.name: Send message to Slack bot
data.evaluateGuide:

Not supported: listing channels, reading messages, managing bot configuration
